Looking for inspiration and develop new skills?
Scritch is an app designed to inspire your drawings and
help you develop new skills
by challenging you with creative constraints that
push you beyond your comfort zone
The challenges mainly involve using different art mediums and supports. Don’t have or want to use some? No worries,
you can customize everything in the settings!
